description: Phase 3-Soak carry-over scenario. Drives the auto-promotion threshold A-vs-B comparison harness: the engine runs with the LOCKED-A 2G defaults (3 families × 30 min × ladder ≥ 3) AND the rig records every Skipped-family snapshot through the threshold_compare harness which evaluates LOCKED-B (4 families × 20 min × ladder ≥ 4) in parallel. The harness does NOT reconfigure the engine — neither set is promoted to engine default at 3-Soak per locked decision 9; the comparison memo informs V4 freeze. Day 1 the rig enables auto-promotion. Day 7 the rig synthesises a burst of route burns to exercise the detector. Day 14 the rig calls the comparison harness; a `comparison-memo.md` artifact is written under the run output dir. The v2-superset distribution-failure invariants continue to assert.
